title: Ramayanam
desc: A religious leader delivers a discourse on the Hindu mythology 'Ramayana' and guides his followers on the path of spirituality.

title: Bhavana
desc: Being the sole breadwinner of her family, Bhavana, a nurse, works hard and sacrifices her needs to support her mother and siblings.

title: Kanyadanam
desc: A father's world revolves around his five daughters as he raises them with a lot of love. However, he wonders if they will receive the same care when they get married and move in with their in-laws.

title: Athira
desc: A kind young woman who loves helping others meets a man who only cares about making money. They have very different views on life, which creates an interesting mix of ideas when they talk.

title: Swayamvarapanthal
desc: Nandini, a devoted village girl, crosses paths with Surya, whose resentment toward his mother drives him to pursue a relationship with her.

title: Constable Manju
desc: Once martyred in the line of duty, a constable's position is inherited by his incorruptible daughter. However, soon, she encounters the benevolent enforcer of a notorious criminal.

title: Mangalyam Thanthunanena
desc: Nidhi, a fearless and kind-hearted young woman, marries her soulmate Gowtham. However, soon she finds herself in the middle of family conspiracies aimed at tearing them apart.
